items.title: AMD Is Behind The AI Chip Shift Nobody Is Talking About
items.summary: AMD and NVIDIA both posted explosive AI quarters, but they are betting on opposite visions of how the AI economy will actually be won. One of those visions fits the next phase of the buildout far better than the market currently appreciates.

items.title: NVIDIA's Hugging Face Buyout: Can It Further Strengthen AI Dominance?
items.summary: NVDA's $12.93B Hugging Face deal is likely to deepen its AI moat by combining chip leadership with a vast open-model platform and developer ecosystem.
